records.title: Restore Our Future independent expenditures, H1 2012 (public summary)
records.provenance: Public FEC independent-expenditure summaries through mid-June 2012, reconstructed as an attributed aggregate. Not a live scrape.
records.text: Restore Our Future, a super PAC supporting Mitt Romney, had reported independent expenditures in the tens of millions of dollars by mid-June 2012 (public FEC summaries). Published coverage described a heavy economy and jobs theme in battleground television markets. Amounts are bands from contemporaneous public filings, not later cycle totals.

records.title: Priorities USA Action independent expenditures, H1 2012 (public summary)
records.provenance: Public FEC independent-expenditure summaries through mid-June 2012, attributed aggregate.
records.text: Priorities USA Action, a super PAC supporting President Obama, had reported independent expenditures by mid-June 2012 in public FEC summaries, at a lower published total than the leading Romney-aligned committee at that date. Coverage described economy and Bain-related themes. Use as contemporaneous metadata, not later cycle totals.

records.title: American Crossroads / Crossroads GPS issue ads, H1 2012 (public summary)
records.provenance: OpenSecrets/FEC public outside-spending summaries as of mid-June 2012. Attributed aggregate.
records.text: American Crossroads and Crossroads GPS were among the largest publicly reported outside spenders in the first half of 2012. Contemporaneous summaries described issue advertising on the economy, spending, and the president's record. This record stores committee, theme, and spend-band metadata only — not creative or targeting files.
